data.explanation: This is your official income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025 from Finanzamt Beispielstadt. It shows your Handwerkerleistungen (craftsman expenses) deduction was accepted and results in a refund of €550, which the tax office will credit automatically to your bank account — no action is needed to receive it. If you think the calculation is wrong, you can file an objection (Einspruch) with Finanzamt Beispielstadt in writing, electronically, or for the record, by the deadline shown. If you miss it, the assessment becomes final and generally can no longer be challenged. Keep this notice for your records, as it can matter for future tax filings.
